### Jesus Is God’s Amen
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/jesus-is-gods-amen
Passage: 2 Corinthians 1:20
Points:
- Prayer connects God's past promises with our future expectations of grace.
- The word "Amen" is an earnest Hebrew affirmation meaning "it is true" or "yes."
- In Jesus Christ, God extends His definitive "Yes" to believers through His promises.
- In prayer, Christians echo God's "Yes" back to Him with "Amen," bringing Him glory.

### Two Verses Pregnant with Hope and Encouragement
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/two-verses-pregnant-with-hope-and-encouragement/
Passage: 2 Corinthians 1:21-22
Points:
- God sovereignly establishes His people and personally ensures they stand firm in Christ.
- The Holy Spirit seals believers as God's treasured possession and daily confirms their belovedness.
- The indwelling Spirit serves as a deposit and guarantee of our promised eternal future.
- Believers are called to walk together in gospel friendship, encouraging one another and working for mutual joy.

### Our Amen to the Glory of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-amen-to-the-glory-of-god
Passage: 2 Corinthians 1:20
Points:
- The word "amen" affirms that a statement or prayer is true, sure, and dependable.
- Ending prayers with "amen" expresses confidence that God hears and responds according to His will.
- Confessing "amen" to historic creeds declares heartfelt reliance on salvation in Christ alone.
- Believers glorify God when they live out their confession in continual, grateful prayer.

### Yes and Amen!
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/yes-and-amen-girlfriends-in-god-apr-5-2013.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 1:20
Points:
- Believers frequently pour faithful labor into others without seeing immediate, visible fruit.
- Remaining attached to Christ guarantees ultimate fruitfulness, regardless of personal timing.
- Every divine promise is dependable because God's word is anchored in His flawless character.
- Believers are freed from controlling outcomes when they place their full confidence in God's promises.
